articles.title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
articles.snippet: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.

articles.title: Circle targets 40 new markets as stablecoin demand grows globally
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer’s CEO Jerermy Allaire told Reuters demand for digital dollars is growing across Asia, Africa and Latin America as banks and payment firms.

articles.title: Circle’s Allaire says stablecoin issuer looking to enter 40 developing markets: Report
articles.snippet: Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East see increasing demand for stablecoins.

articles.title: Stablecoin remittances cost 84% less than traditional transfers, report finds
articles.snippet: Borderless.xyz data shows major savings on cross-border business payments, with stablecoin transfers also settling faster than traditional international bank wires.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street closes at 4. Tokenized stocks keep trading
articles.snippet: Tokenized stocks are drawing trading activity beyond Wall Street hours, while Bitcoin miners confront costly AI expansion and new accounting rules could benefit stablecoins.
